# Fixture provenance

- All `*.synthetic.json` and `*.synthetic.html` files are generated from fictional identities, labels, timestamps and media paths by `npm run fixtures:data`. No live server, creator, channel or message data is used to generate them.
- The generated cases cover 32 messages/57 attachments, 209 messages over two pages, empty pages, 65 channel links including threads, and a post with a main file but no attachments. These counts describe test scenarios, not live archive observations.
- `test-image.jpg` is an original geometric JPEG generated by `npm run fixtures:image`, covered by this project's MIT license. Browser tests serve JPEG bytes under advertised PNG names to verify content-based extensions.
- Decoder fixtures and upstream notices are documented in [archives/README.md](archives/README.md). They contain generated text or licensed libarchive test data.

`npm run privacy:check` checks exact generated metadata/HTML bytes, reviewed asset digests, secret patterns and excluded private/generated paths. Live research requires explicit IDs and writes only ignored `artifacts/recon/`; captures never replace these fixtures.
